description: The operating capacity of the wind farm will be between 924 MW and 1,034 MW.

description: The export cable will be buried at a target depth of 3 to 7 feet.

description: The temporary pier will extend approximately 240 feet offshore.

description: Production piles will be 14 x 14 inch H-shaped or 16-inch diameter round steel.

description: WTGs will extend up to 787 ft above mean sea level.
context_quote: Sunrise Wind proposes the installation of up to 94 WTGs within 102 potential positions extending up to 787 ft (240 m) above mean sea level (AMSL).

description: Turbines will be sited in a uniform grid with 1.15 by 1.15-mile spacing.
context_quote: Turbines would be sited in a uniform east-west/northsouth grid with 1.15 by 1.15-mile (mi) (1 by 1-nautical mile [nm]; 1.85 by 1.85 kilometer [km]) spacing.

description: Sunrise Wind would maintain diagonal lanes between 0.7 and 0.9 mi wide when micrositing foundations.

description: WTG foundations would be 39 ft in diameter at the seabed.
context_quote: The WTG foundations as proposed in the COP would be 39 ft (12 m) in diameter at the seabed and 23 ft (7 m) in diameter at the sea surface (Sunrise Wind 2022).
